content.title: Queue PDF exports from each export action
content.intent: Prove the export format can be changed from the default to PDF before queuing any export action and a success toast is shown.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning across the four export actions with the PDF format fixed, because the source promised the same success-feedback outcome regardless of the chosen export action. Used covering-array authority over input classes {action}; requested strength 2 from the user-reach-only risk profile and accepted the tool's degradation to strength 1 because only one varying input remained after fixing format to PDF. Kept this separate from the CSV path because changing away from the default creates a distinct journey that must prove the non-default format can be selected before export. Skipped boundary, negative, state-flow, auth, persistence, i18n, a11y, responsiveness, and pagination for the same evidence-based reasons as the other export paths. Estimated total design size remained 4 scenario/test pairs, below budget ceiling 8.
